notes.title: INFEST Update 0.9.5 – The Road to Version 1.0!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce INFEST Update 0.9.5, packed with gameplay balance updates, level design improvements, bug fixes, and a brand-new quality-of-life feature. This update marks a significant milestone as we gear up to leave Early Access with Version 1.0 very soon!

Key Highlights in 0.9.5

⚖️ Balancing Improvements
- Weapons, abilities, and enemies have been finely tuned to deliver a more intense and rewarding challenge.
- Strategy is king—your choices will matter more than ever as pacing and difficulty have been refined.

🌌 Level Design Enhancements
- Improved level layouts to provide more dynamic and engaging gameplay.
- New environmental hazards and smarter resource placements make every run fresh and exciting.

🛠️ Bug Fixes
- Addressed several key bugs (the code kind, not the alien kind) to enhance stability and performance.
- Optimized gameplay to ensure smoother runs and better quality of life for all players.

🗑️ New Feature: Delete Game Runs
- You asked, we delivered! You can now delete your current game run directly from the game settings. Whether you want to start fresh or free up space for your next masterpiece of a build, you’re in control.

Version 1.0 is Near

With this update, INFEST is inching closer to leaving Early Access and launching Version 1.0. Your support, feedback, and enthusiasm have shaped the game into what it is today, and we’re almost ready to share the final polished experience with the world. Keep your eyes peeled—the full launch is just around the corner.

We Need Your Feedback

Your input has been invaluable throughout Early Access, and this update is no different. Let us know what you think about the new balancing, level design, and features as we sprint toward 1.0.

Thank you for joining us on this journey.

-INFEST Team

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE V0.9 is LIVE
notes.notes:
Survivors, this update brings a whole new level of strategic depth to INFEST! 

https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2341560/extras/electric-ezgif.com-optimize.gif?t=1730307254

Here’s what’s new:

⚡ Dynamic Water-Electricity Interactions
Water now conducts electricity, creating lethal shock zones for enemies—use the environment to your advantage!

🌩 Targeted Lightning
Your lightning strikes have been upgraded! The first bolt now lands exactly where you aim, creating an electrifying source right at the cursor position.

🛢 Enhanced Oil-Water Behavior
Oil now floats atop water, adding extra tactical options for combining elements and manipulating the battlefield.

💥 Improved Bomb Mechanics
Double-launched bombs are now smarter—they won’t collide with a defeated enemy, ensuring a clear path to your next target.

🛡 Reworked Blocking System
Blocking just got a massive upgrade. Blocks now absorb entire attacks, including status effects, rather than just damage points. Earn bonus blocks when you’re lucky or nail a combo!

📜 Streamlined Starting Decks
All characters now start with 8 cards, setting you up for faster and more efficient gameplay right from the start.

💫 More Balances & Tweaks
This update also brings many smaller balance adjustments to fine-tune gameplay and keep INFEST challenging and fun.

Jump into INFEST, experiment with these changes, and let us know your thoughts! Happy deck-building! 

INFEST Team

notes.title: INFEST Update V0.8 is Live!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that INFEST has just received a massive update with version 0.8! We've listened to your feedback and worked hard to bring some exciting new features, improvements, and adjustments that we think you'll love. Here’s what’s new:

🗺 Overworld Updates:

Added Overworld Names to give more personality to your exploration.
Reworked the Overworld Pathing for a fresh strategic layer to your journey.

🎯 Combat Improvements:

New Confusion Indicators on aiming lines to help you navigate tricky situations.

Transform Cards have been revamped! They now automatically affect many element types, streamlining your gameplay experience.

Toxic Gas Cloud has been expanded to have a wider area of effect, making it deadlier and more strategic.

📚 Tutorial Enhancements:

Expanded tutorial tips to help guide new players and refresh veterans on key mechanics.
⚖ Balance & Performance:

The overall difficulty has been increased, so prepare for a more intense challenge.
We’ve made lots of balancing adjustments, performance optimizations, and squashed many bugs to keep the gameplay smooth and exciting.

Thank you for your ongoing support. Let us know your thoughts on these updates in the Steam forums or via our Discord community. Keep the feedback coming, and stay tuned for more exciting updates!

-INFEST Team

notes.title: Major Update V0.6 and Upcoming Early Access Release!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We've been working hard on INFEST and have just released V0.6 of the demo. It has a lot of adjustments and overall quality of life and balancing improvements, including:

adjusted difficulty (slightly harder)
adjusted the way clicks interact with cards (activates now on down click)
card play timer from 25s to 60s
Enemy bullets now cut through the environment
UI Improvements
performance improvements

ALSO

INFEST will be entering early access this summer, so stay tuned for an announcement for the official launch date.
